Benchmark Throughput, Latency Quantiles, and Retry Rate on a Local Runtime

Source: R/benchmark.R
benchmark_local_runtime.Rd

Runs a controlled offline pilot benchmark of airgap_extract() on a sample of rows (supplied via data or generated synthetically when data = NULL) using any local or mock runtime, reporting throughput (rows_per_sec), estimated full-corpus ETA, schema validation success rate, repair retry rate, and per-row latency quantiles (min, p50, mean, p95, max in milliseconds). Never stores or prints raw participant text.

Usage

benchmark_local_runtime(
  runtime,
  schema,
  data = NULL,
  text_col = NULL,
  n_sample = 10L,
  corpus_size = NULL,
  pii_policy = c("redact", "verified_deidentified"),
  pii_config = NULL,
  max_retries = 2L,
  prompt_template = NULL,
  container_spec = NULL
)

Arguments

runtime

An airgap_runtime object from runtime_ollama(), runtime_openai_local(), or runtime_mock().

schema

An extraction_schema() object.

data

Optional data frame containing sample text rows. If NULL, synthesizes deterministic synthetic clinical benchmark sentences.

text_col

Character scalar text column name (required when data is supplied).

n_sample

Positive integer number of rows to benchmark (default 10L). When data has fewer than n_sample rows, benchmarks all rows of data.

corpus_size

Optional positive integer target full-corpus size used to project estimated runtime ETA. Defaults to nrow(data) when data is supplied, or 1000L otherwise.

pii_policy

Pre-inference privacy policy: "redact" (default) or "verified_deidentified".

pii_config

Optional pii_config() object.

max_retries

Non-negative integer maximum structured repair retries per row (default 2L).

prompt_template

Optional prompt template override.

container_spec

Optional airgap_container_spec().

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_benchmark" containing model, backend_type, n_sample, rows_succeeded, rows_failed, success_rate_pct, total_retries, repair_retry_rate_pct, elapsed_sec, rows_per_sec, latency_ms (list of min, p50, mean, p95, max), corpus_size, estimated_eta_sec, estimated_eta_formatted, and benchmarked_at.

Examples

sc <- extraction_schema(
  sentiment = schema_field("enum", values = c("positive", "neutral", "negative")),
  severity = schema_field("integer", min = 0L, max = 10L)
)
bm <- benchmark_local_runtime(runtime_mock(seed = 42L), sc, n_sample = 6L, corpus_size = 5000L)
bm
#> <airgap_benchmark> [mock | mock-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-q4]
#>   Sample rows:     6 (succeeded=6 [100%], failed=0)
#>   Repair retries:  0 total (0% of rows retried)
#>   Throughput:      375.00 rows/sec (elapsed=0.016s)
#>   Latency (ms):    p50=1 | p95=1 | mean=0.83 (range 0-1)
#>   Projected ETA:   13.3 sec for 5000 rows
